claims: Luke Murray was hired as Boston College men's basketball head coach in March 2026, according to WBUR News.
Luke Murray served as an assistant coach at UConn from 2021–2026.
Luke Murray won back-to-back national championships in 2023 and 2024 as an assistant coach at UConn, as detailed on the UConn Athletics website.
Luke Murray has been coaching in college basketball since 2007, notes the University of Connecticut Athletics website.
Luke Murray had stints at Wagner, Rhode Island, Xavier, and Louisville before joining Dan Hurley's staff at UConn, notes the University of Connecticut Athletics website.
Luke Murray is one of two children from Bill Murray's first marriage to Mickey Kelley, according to Wikipedia.
